meta.title: sitemap.pi
meta.description: A directory to discover and promote .pi sites built on Pi Network

home.title: sitemap.pi
home.description: Discover .pi sites built on Pi Network in one place. Your site is listed once the usage fee (Pi) is paid.

fee.discountLifetime: {pct}% off vs. monthly rate on a 10-year basis

bubble.canvasLabel: Site bubbles — size shows the plan (ad/own), color shows the view change. Tab to move, Enter to open

ad.title: Register my business!
ad.lead: Your business is awaited here. Register your Pi site and it appears on screen as a brilliant bubble.
ad.full: All plan slots are taken right now. Please check back later.
ad.step1: 1. Register my business - choose a plan, register → pay in Pi
ad.step2: 2. Use starts automatically once the agreed time after payment has passed.
ad.step3: 3. During the usage period, your site appears as a home bubble at the chosen plan size.

auth.required: Please sign in with your Pi account.
auth.openInPiBrowser: Open this page in Pi Browser to sign in with your Pi account.
auth.linkRequired: You are signed in with Google, but it is not linked to a Pi account yet. Issue a link code in Pi Browser and enter it here.
auth.linkCheckFailed: Could not check your account link status (temporary server error). Please refresh in a moment.

piOAuth.signingIn: Signing in with your Pi account…
piOAuth.failed: Pi sign-in failed. Please try again.
piOAuth.stateMismatch: Could not verify this sign-in request (expired or another tab). Please try again.

link.title: Link account
link.intro: Connect the account you signed in with in Pi Browser to Google sign-in in a regular browser. After linking you can use the same account on a PC browser.
link.piIssueTitle: To sign in from a regular browser too
link.codeHint: Issue the code below, then sign in with Google on a PC browser and enter it on the Link account page (within 10 minutes).
link.enterHint: In Pi Browser open sitemap.pi → Link account → Issue link code, then enter the 6-digit code.
link.done: Linked. You can now use Google sign-in as well.

rjctRsn.PI_BRAND: Pi-prefixed domain or Pi logo use

detail.leaveTitle: You are leaving for an external site
detail.leaveBody: You are leaving sitemap.pi for the site below. Its content and payments are the responsibility of its operator.

report.title: Report site
report.done: Your report was received and will be reviewed.

me.title: My sites
me.empty: You have not listed any sites.
me.withdrawConfirm: Withdraw the listing for {domain}? It will be removed from the directory.
me.verifyGuide: Domain ownership check (optional): publish only the value below at {url} on your site. Used for the operator-verified badge.
me.payHint: Use starts automatically once the configured time after paying the usage fee has passed. Applications that do not start payment within the configured time are rejected. Payment works in Pi Browser only.
me.payDeadline: Payment deadline: the application is rejected automatically if payment is not started within the configured time.
me.useStartAt: Payment complete. Use starts automatically once the configured time has passed.
me.reapplyUntil: Usage has ended. Re-register within the configured window to keep this domain.
me.spkGo: Pay {amount} Pi for the sparkle add-on

pay.done: Payment complete. Use starts automatically once the configured time has passed.
pay.piBrowserOnly: Payments work in Pi Browser only. Please open this page in Pi Browser.
pay.title: Pay usage fee
pay.intro: Pay the amount below in Pi and use starts once the configured time has passed. Payments work in Pi Browser only.
pay.name: Site name
pay.alreadyPaid: This application is already paid. Use will start shortly.
pay.notRequired: No payment is required for this application.
pay.notPayable: Payment is not available in the current status. Check the application in My sites.
pay.timeout: No response from payment. Please try again in Pi Browser.
pay.payNowSpk: Pay {amount} Pi for the sparkle add-on
pay.spkAlreadyPaid: The sparkle add-on is already paid.

form.piBrandWarn: Domains starting with 'pi' may be rejected or suspended under the Pi trademark policy.
form.name: Site name
form.imageHint: PNG, JPEG, WebP or GIF, up to 2MB. Automatically fitted to a 300×300 px square (center crop) and shown as a round logo in the home bubbles and lists. Inappropriate images lead to rejection or suspension.
form.pvtHint: Used only for operator inquiries and never shown. Required to apply.
form.pvtRequired: An operator contact is required to apply.
form.pubHint: Shown on the site page if provided.
form.mvHint: An https address for regular browsers that cannot open .pi. Cannot be changed while in use.
form.planHint: The plan sets the home bubble size, usage period and usage fee (Pi). Discounts are relative to the 1-month rate; use starts after the usage fee is paid.
form.planLocked: The plan cannot be changed while in use.
form.spkHint: Makes your home bubble sparkle. Paid together with the usage fee, or turned on in Edit while in use with a separate payment.
form.spkPaid: Paid — stays on for the usage period.

admin.title: Site admin
admin.memoPlaceholder: Reason or note (optional, shown to the owner)
admin.verifyStep1: Open this address in Pi Browser and confirm it matches the token exactly
admin.verifyStep2: If it differs or does not open, reject with reason "Domain ownership not verified" — the same owner cannot apply for this domain again
admin.verifyStep3: Confirm the site content matches the listing and the prohibited-category rules
